compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner selling an integrated product and engineering-delivery offer, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency described in the current company documents. The page also includes unsupported claims about performance, security, company scale, social profiles, and office locations.

llm_problems.title: Old Applied AI positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page positions GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that deploys a product and engineers to deliver features, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Rewrite the page around the approved company description and the two current staffing and recruiting services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning and offer
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers
